selection_authority: Direct review of the complete English example, adjacent productivity context and Chinese explanatory syntax. Explicit R、C、U keeps the original three Latin letters without an invented expansion. Not recognizer voting or acoustic approval.

samples.source: For example, if you put me in Linux kernel RCU, which I originated and I'm lead maintainer of, I can do pretty well. If you threw me into some random web framework or something like that, it probably would take me some time before I could learn enough about it to do anything at all.
